fields.summary_ko.0: Visa Inc. (V) is a payment technology company that processes authorization, payment, and settlement through VisaNet, providing payment services including credit cards, debit cards, prepaid cards, tap-to-pay, tokenization, and click-to-pay
fields.summary_ko.1: Provides diverse financial and consulting services including Visa Direct (money movement platform), issuance solutions, merchant acceptance solutions, and risk detection, founded in 1958 and headquartered in San Francisco
